result.reason: The operative language gives Licensee the preferred 30-day convenience-termination right, imposes no penalty, and requires a refund of prepaid fees allocable to the post-termination period. It gives Licensor no convenience-termination right during the committed term. However, allowing termination “in whole or in part” goes beyond the playbook requirement and introduces avoidable ambiguity regarding partial-termination scope and refund allocation. The margin comment’s request to limit Licensor’s breach-termination right is not implemented, but that issue is outside the stated T4C rule.
